project.title: reDB: the AI agent that tunes IBM Db2 and proves every fix
project.short_description: A LangGraph + Gemini agent that reads Db2's MON_GET monitoring, explains slow queries from EXPLAIN plans, proposes indexes from Db2's own advisor and guarded rewrites, proves each fix with virtual-index costs and EXCEPT ALL equivalence, applies it only after human approval, measures the real speed-up, and audits everything in a temporal table with rollback and VECTOR case memory.
project.category: AI / Database Performance / Autonomous DBA Agent

members.name: Mohamed Atiyah
members.role: Solo developer: Db2 integration, LangGraph agent, UI, docs

features_used: CURRENT EXPLAIN MODE RECOMMEND INDEXES + ADVISE_INDEX (virtual indexes)
CURRENT EXPLAIN MODE EVALUATE INDEXES (workload-level what-if index consolidation)
Informational constraints (NOT ENFORCED ENABLE QUERY OPTIMIZATION)
